title: YouthSafe: A Youth-Centric Safety Benchmark and Safeguard Model for Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating LLM guardrail models on their ability to detect and classify conversational snippets containing biased gender content, microaggressions, and youth-specific stereotype reinforcement within the curated YAIR benchmark dataset.

Evaluating LLM guardrail models on their ability to detect and classify conversational snippets containing racist content, biased ethnic content, and inadequate skin tone diversity representations within the curated YAIR benchmark dataset.
